pages.text: Supply depots retain guards, carriers, usable storage, and restoration materials. Look for lit lamps, old roads, and masonry. Written ledgers explain how damaged cores can receive new orders.

Archives contain bookshelves, tablets, extra defenders, and an ancient commander. Records describe the kingdom’s beginnings and orders left after the traveler vanished. Chests contain seals and supplies.

Rarer royal wards hold crests, banners, a castellan, and additional guards. Recover the last watch’s record and extra seals. Ruins generate in new chunks; existing builds and saved companions remain intact.
